race.comment: BLACK PEPPERMINT (1) steps up to the 3100m and looks well placed for it. For an 8yo, he's relatively lightly raced with 22 starts under his belt, getting home well for third at Geelong last start in a stronger race. Turns around quickly here and should stay well. REDDIVO (2) won two in a route over this route before going to Mornington and battling away. Comes back home now and should go close. LEGEND BEAST (4) has been okay this time in but wasn't far away in a bunched finish at Swan Hill last time and should be running on. MATTHEW MARK (7) tried hard behind REDDIVO here last time and should take catching despite a gap between runs.
